description: Hand-curated competency mapping for NYSC COURSE-009 Information And Communication Technolory Technician against its linked records. A DOCUMENTED cell cites the exact stored text that names the competency. NOT_EXPLICIT means the available description does not name it, not that it is absent from teaching. INSUFFICIENT_DATA means the stored text is unavailable, outside the record's scope, or too ambiguous to assess.
method: The NYSC column was assessed by hand against this course's own governed module headings; a broad heading does not establish a more specific competency. COURSE-009 is the 6-month full-time NVQ Level 4 course; its merged heading 10 is not cited. NYSC citations keep the exact governed text; where the snapshot holds a verified display correction for that heading, display_text carries the corrected wording. Coverage is never inferred from programme titles, qualification levels or unstored text.

ict_word_processing: creating, formatting or editing word-processed documents
ict_graphics_multimedia: producing graphics, print layouts or multimedia objects
ict_system_maintenance: maintaining or troubleshooting computer systems and peripherals

methodology.DOCUMENTED: The cited stored text explicitly names the competency. Coverage records whether it names every component of the category (FULL) or only some (PARTIAL).
methodology.FULL: The cited evidence supports the competency as labelled: every listed component of the category is explicitly named.
methodology.PARTIAL: Only a component of the category, or a lower level of activity, is explicitly documented; supported_component records what is supported.
methodology.NOT_EXPLICIT: The competency is not documented within the available, assessed scope of the source (unit titles, learning outcomes or core units as stored).
methodology.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Missing or incomplete material prevents a reliable assessment.
methodology.caution: None of these statuses proves that a competency is or is not actually taught.
methodology.areas_rule: Areas to Investigate list competencies that the NYSC description does not name (NOT_EXPLICIT) and that at least two distinct comparator records, from at least two different countries, document with FULL coverage. PARTIAL evidence is shown but not counted.
decisions: The Sri Lankan NCS K72S004 is linked as the package matching each course: NVQ Level 4 ICT Technician for COURSE-009 and NVQ Level 3 Computer Application Assistant for COURSE-053/054.
TESDA Computer Systems Servicing NC II and ITE IT Systems & Networks are reused for COURSE-009 only, for the technical-support part of the ICT Technician role.
COURSE-009's flagged merged heading 10 is not cited; web-design and software-development NYSC cells are INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
ICT20120 electives are not assessed; 'Operate application software packages' is partial support for office applications.
